sources.title: Running PyTorch Models on Apple Silicon GPUs with the ExecuTorch MLX ...
sources.snippet: The MLX delegate is a new ExecuTorch backend that compiles and runs PyTorch models on Apple Silicon GPUs. You export your model using the standard ExecuTorch pipeline, and the delegate handles the rest: partitioning the graph, serializing it into an optimized format, and dispatching operations to MLX's Metal GPU kernels at runtime.
